metadata.title: Kako mladi vidijo Evropo – zaznave osmošolcev o Evropi in Evropski uniji: Nacionalno poročilo Evropskega regionalnega modula ICCS 2022

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: The report summarizes results from the ICCS 2022 European Regional Module (ERM) administered to Grade 8 students (with Norway using Grade 9). It reports national and European comparisons using ICCS/ERM scaling conventions (European average fixed at 50 with SD=10 for equally weighted national samples meeting sampling requirements). The text does not specify whether complex survey weights and replicate weights were applied in the Slovenian national reporting, nor does it name any weight variables (e.g., W_FSTUWT, TOTWGT) or replication method (BRR/jackknife). Because this is a descriptive national report focusing on percentages and scale means rather than an ML modeling pipeline, the manuscript does not provide enough methodological detail to confirm weight usage; readers should rely on the ICCS technical documentation for the official weighting and variance estimation procedures.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This publication is a national descriptive report of students’ attitudes, perceptions, and self-reported behaviors from the ICCS 2022 European Regional Module, which is based on Likert-type questionnaire items rather than cognitive achievement scores with plausible values. As a result, plausible values handling is not applicable to the reported outcomes. The report also does not document a missing-data strategy (e.g., listwise/pairwise deletion or imputation), which is common in descriptive reporting when the focus is on published percentages/scale means rather than re-estimation details.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: The report uses ICCS 2022 data for Slovenia including the European Regional Module ERM. It states that in Slovenia ICCS 2022 (including the ERM) was fielded between April and June 2022 and that 4,958 students participated from 177 schools; it also notes a split between main paper-based sample and a 'bridge' component (1,478 on paper). For the ERM results, the target population is Grade 8 students (about age 14), with Norway as an exception using Grade 9; the report indicates that results are representative for the national Grade 8 population in Slovenia.

data.outcome_summary: This national report presents first results from the ICCS 2022 European Regional Module (ERM) for Slovenia, focusing on Grade 8 students’ attitudes, perceptions, and self-reported behaviors related to Europe and the European Union. The report uses Likert-type questionnaire items (and derived scales) and compares Slovenian results to a European average benchmark (European average fixed at 50 with SD=10 for equally weighted national samples meeting sampling requirements). Across domains, Slovenian students show a stronger European identity than the European average, report relatively high opportunities to learn about the EU, and express generally pro-environmental cooperation attitudes, though overall sustainable behavior and some mobility attitudes are slightly below European norms. The report also documents item-level differences in political consumerism and higher-than-average negative expectations about Europe’s future. Limitations include the absence of an ML modeling framework, no documented missing-data strategy, and no causal claims—policy implications are therefore interpretive rather than evidence of effects.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction targets an official assessment framework, user guide, or technical manual without an empirical ML study. Sample sizes, ML algorithms, and predictive findings are intentionally null or empty per schema rules for non-empirical IEA/OECD documentation.
